title: Solid Hitbox
description: Make every Hitbox in the game solid!
body:
Have you ever wanted every Entity to have a solid hitbox?

No? Too bad! You’re downloading this mod anyway :D

### Featurez
With Solid Hitbox, every entity now has a fully solid hitbox.
Yep… that’s literally it.

If the Player drops a item, the item will be flinged away.
